A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same ArenaRL research work and complete Appendices A–F. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that pages 2–38 are identical; differences are confined to the first page.

before.justification: v1 reports original ArenaRL experiments on agent and writing benchmarks, tournament comparisons, ablations, and business scenarios in Section 6, Tables 2–4, and Figure 4.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results, including benchmark evaluations, ablations, and the comparative trajectories in Appendix F.

M1.justification: The process-aware pairwise judge, tournament procedures, rank-based rewards, and policy objective are identical in Sections 3–4 and Appendix D's Algorithm 1.

E1.justification: Both versions use Open-Travel, Open-DeepResearch, DeepWriting-20K training data, WritingBench, HelloBench, LongBench-write, and the same Amap business scenarios. Task, language, and generalization coverage are unchanged.

E2.justification: Tables 2–4 retain identical tournament comparisons and baseline membership, including SFT, GRPO, GSPO, GPT-4o, Grok-4, Gemini-2.5-pro, and Claude-3.7-Sonnet.

E3.justification: Dataset splits and sizes, model configurations, group sizes, judge models, evaluation metrics, and training settings match throughout Sections 5–6 and Appendix A.

E4.justification: The tournament comparison, group-size ablation, human–LLM agreement analysis, direct RL experiment without cold start, and Appendix F case studies are all retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Figure 1's repeated-evaluation noise description and the uncertainty-reporting practices throughout the experiments are identical. No run-count disclosure, confidence interval, or significance test is added or revised.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results match, including Tables 2–4, Figure 4, business outcomes, and Appendix F. Table 3 retains ArenaRL's 41.8% Open-Travel mean win rate and 64.3% Open-DeepResearch mean win rate with 99.0% valid generation.

T1.justification: The trajectory definition, reward-noise formulation, tournament complexity reasoning, and mathematical objectives in Sections 3–4 are unchanged. No formal assumption, derivation, or proof is added or corrected.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about discriminative collapse, tournament-based optimization, linear-complexity seeded elimination, and the two full-cycle agent benchmarks.

C2.justification: Explanations involving reward noise, seeding, exploration, context overflow, human agreement, and knowledge-limited writing performance are unchanged, as are the applicability discussion and future directions.

D1.justification: The abstract's code hyperlink changes from an internal PDF destination in v1 to an external URI in v3, correcting navigation to the same printed repository address. Implementation details and appendix prompts are unchanged; the PDFs establish no change in repository contents or availability.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the reference list are identical, including the positioning against Writing-Zero and Pref-GRPO. No cited work or novelty comparison is added or removed.

P1.justification: v3 adds equal-contribution attribution for Qiang Zhang and Fanrui Zhang and changes Jiawei Liu's corresponding-author symbol. Scientific prose, terminology, and section and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The first-page author line and footnote accommodate the new contribution markers, and the marginal arXiv version/date stamp changes. All figures, tables, and page layouts from pages 2–38 render identically.

improvement.justification: The scientific argument, experimental evidence, technical documentation, and complete appendices are unchanged. v3 clarifies author credit and repairs code-link navigation, but these small front-matter and usability corrections do not meaningfully alter the paper's overall quality.
